artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan building TM-star (StarAxiom via ofBase + 16 register schemata, StarDerivationTree with the notation for star-derivability), its soundness, the TM-plus embedding, and the conservativity trio, with TM-star completeness recorded as OPEN under two named obstructions.

memory_candidates.content: When extending a formal language in the BimodalLogic tree (L-minus -> L -> L-plus -> L-star), the decisive planning question is which existing schema proofs consume a TRANSPORT lemma (timeShift, atomization, state-determinacy) rather than being definitional. Grep the soundness module for the transport lemma's consumers first: in the TM block, modal_future is the SOLE timeShift consumer, and it is exactly the one schema that fails to transfer to StarFormula. That single grep decides whether the extension's axiom set can be embedded wholesale via a single ofBase constructor (soundness for the whole inherited block becomes a two-line transport along the validity-transfer lemma) or must be re-declared schema by schema (N direct validity plus N swap-validity proofs). The embedding choice also determines whether auxiliary predicates (purity, free-variable/register predicates) are needed at all: under an ofBase embedding they are not, because the inherited constructors carry their side conditions on the SOURCE language's formulas.
